header: A tick and an answer for each criterion
lead: For comparing two options. The tick shows whether this option covers a criterion, and the next column says how the alternative handles it.
caption: Name both options here. The column headings stay generic, so the caption carries the real names.
note: Each tick has a text label in the markup, so screen reader users know what it means.

rows.title: A covered criterion
rows.text: The text next to the tick says what the other option does instead.

rows.title: A criterion both sides cover
rows.text: Say so plainly. Readers do not trust a comparison that concedes nothing.

rows.title: A criterion this option does not cover
rows.text: The cross is grey, not red, because not every gap is a failure.
